heading: Certification of rental proceeds
lead: Notwithstanding any other provision of law, any actual rental proceeds from the lease of land acquired under section 5136 of this title certified by the Secretary of the Interior shall be deemed—

tree.text: to constitute the rental value of that land; and
to satisfy the requirement for appraisal of that land.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 494a of this title prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
